notes.title: June is on KICKSTARTER
notes.content:
[h1]🔥We just launched the Kickstarter🔥[/h1]

https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/junethegame/june-tales-from-cyberspace

We’re so thrilled to share with you the journey in creating her universe!
[i]Watch the team telling the story of June's birth...[/i]

[previewyoutube=bmy1jR--584;full][/previewyoutube]

If you feel like giving a hand and support this incredible adventure on Kickstarter, get beta/early access to the game.

For true art lovers, we also prepared some[b] 3D printed[/b] sculptures extracted from June's world.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40696324/44b9ea82600001ee02ce12a0f7c5edef7102e526.gif[/img]

With your help, we’ll be able to bring this project to the level of our ambition, and create a true home for June in the [b]metaverse[/b].

[h2]So… DO IT FOR JUNE ![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40696324/4f3c1cd8bbd04520f4eb2e8f559d3936ef4b62eb.png[/img]
